rows.reason: Core selection and ISA configuration are fixed choices; no statistical quantity.
Interconnect topology is verified by bit-exact functional regression.
Address map and reset vector are fixed constants checked by functional tests.
Boot ROM behaviour is verified by bit-exact functional regression.
Peripheral behaviour is verified by bit-exact functional regression against golden transcripts.
Single clock and reset scheme; sequencing is checked by functional simulation.
Architectural and firmware tests are pass/fail with exact expected results.
Integration RTL is digital logic checked by bit-exact functional regression.
A pinned PDK variant and revision; a configuration choice, not a measured quantity.
A selected standard-cell library; a configuration choice, not a measured quantity.
A selected supply voltage; a configuration choice, bounded by the library corners.
Macro instance count and interface are fixed by the consumed macro's ratified spec.
Fmax is bounded by static timing analysis at the listed corners, not by a distribution.
Signoff is DRC and LVS pass/fail plus static timing closure at every listed corner.
